Theme from Gboard
Gboard shares a theme as a ZIP file, and the Rboard community shares hundreds of them. Open a ZIP file that you have, or look through the Rboard collection.

resources.string: Add all
Some style sheets in the file are compiled or missing. The app used the ones that it can read.
The file has its own pictures for keys such as shift, delete and enter. This app draws its own icons on those keys.
The file sets the space inside each key. This app uses one gap between keys for the whole keyboard.
The file asks for a font by name. Gboard themes do not contain the font, so install it yourself and pick it in the theme editor.
The file picks a colour for the shadows under the keys. The shadows come across, but this app draws them in its own colour.
The file rounds some corners one at a time, such as the top of the keyboard. This app uses one corner size for each key.
The file puts pictures on parts of the keyboard other than the background and the keys. This app does not use those pictures.
Rboard themes

Rboard is a community collection of Gboard themes. The app gets the list from the Rboard repository on GitHub when you open this screen, and gets a pack only when you press it. The themes stay the work of the people who made them.
